variants.name: 铅丹赤
variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, production game sprite. Edit the attached APPROVED B pill body ONLY by changing its painted mineral color. Preserve B's exact round whole-pill shape, center, scale, thin warm-brown drawn contour, sparse dry-brush texture, three quiet painted value masses, upper-left broad matte light plane and diagonal painted shadow organization. Keep the dense fine-powder compact medicine appearance. DO NOT add realism, continuous 3D gradients, white specular glint, veins, grit, chips, facets, cracks, runes, emblems, seams, words, background, frame, extra objects or cast shadow outside the body. The quiet central face receives existing live game rune overlays later. Preserve true alpha transparency outside the pill. The whole image is the same single body on transparent background. Preserve the entire silhouette, no cropping. COLOR TARGET: historical red-lead/minium pigment color, a dense opaque subdued ORANGE-RED mineral pigment inspired by Pb3O4, not metallic lead and not cinnabar. Muted terracotta orange-red body around #B84D32, clay-orange lighter upper-left plane around #D37A50, deep red-brown shadow around #71372C. These hex values are art targets, not measurements. No yellow gold sheen, pink plastic, glass, jade, neon, fiery effects or shiny red lacquer. The original B material and brush structure remain unmistakable.
